property_summary: An admin addresses the isAdmin mapping after being set; the reference version allows the admin to call newEmergencyOracle, while the second version with the negated modifier (require(!isAdmin[msg.sender])) incorrectly reverts when the same admin calls it.
change_summary: -require(isAdmin[msg.sender], "Only admin can call address(this) function");; +require(!isAdmin[msg.sender], "Only admin can call address(this) function");
